newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle slow at $67, off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle slow at $67, off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady to mostly $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand light.

Sales confirmed on 3,800 slaughter steers and 5,100 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 76,400 head confirmed including 14,800 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00; few Select with end Choice 67.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1075 lbs 67.00; load Select with end Choice 1150 lbs 67.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1000- 1150 lb heiferettes and cows 64.50-67.00.
Wk to date - 76,400 last week - 52,400 last year - 14,800
